summary: Dr. Reddy's Laboratories filed a Form 6-K furnishing an intimation dated September 10, 2026, disclosing the allotment of 375 equity shares of Re.1 each, fully paid, to eligible employees upon exercise of stock options under the Dr. Reddy's Employees ADR Stock Options Scheme, 2007. The disclosure satisfies Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations and Regulation 10(c) of the SEBI Share Based Employee Benefits Regulations, 2021. No special-situation transaction is involved. The issuance is de minimis, has no material capital structure or overhang effect, and no board recommendation, advisor, premium, or deal terms apply.
